addProduct.question: How do I add a new product to my store?
addProduct.answer: To add a new product, go to Products Management, click 'Add Product', fill in the required details including title, price, description, and upload product images. Don't forget to set your inventory quantity and shipping details.

trackSales.question: How can I track my sales performance?
trackSales.answer: Visit the Analytics Dashboard to view comprehensive sales data, including total revenue, order counts, and performance trends. You can also access detailed reports in the Reports & Analytics section.

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods are supported?
paymentMethods.answer: We support all major payment methods including credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and bank transfers depending on your region.

shippingRates.question: How do I set up shipping rates?
shippingRates.answer: Go to Shipping & Logistics, click 'Add Carrier' or 'Shipping Settings' to configure your shipping zones, rates, and delivery options. You can set flat rates, weight-based pricing, or free shipping thresholds.

customizeStore.question: Can I customize my store appearance?
customizeStore.answer: Yes! In Profile Settings, you can customize your store name, logo, description, and business information. For advanced customization, contact our support team for additional options.
